rule: New sessions may repair defects against evidence, but may not reinterpret or weaken these rules.
protected_rules: Broker top-level access is Broker HQ only.
Broker profile functionality is retained inside Broker HQ; the profile implementation is not deleted.
Broker discovery/market and service map are inside Broker HQ; broker must not use public market.html.
Government housing reference information is public from the main experience and role-visible to seeker, owner, and broker in profile surfaces.
Seeker and broker may save property listings; owner and broker may save wanted listings; these are counterpart discovery surfaces.
House 1 is the only inter-house transit hub.
House 2↔House 3 has no direct physical route.
Physical travel never changes authenticated identity or role.
A Broker cannot become Seeker/Owner by traveling; explicit authentication identity transition is required.
Client role caches are never authorization authority and are cleared on logout.
Canonical SH3D remains the physical authority; 3d/imports and 3d/staging SH3Ds are evidence-only.
Runtime physical routes require physical evidence and route validation; logical links alone never promote a route.
Suspension expiry must reconcile both Firestore state and Firebase Auth disabled state.
Phone identity validation uses exactly 12 digits in canonical Philippine mobile format 639XXXXXXXXX.
repair_policy: If a protected rule is wrong, update the rule only with explicit evidence and a new checkpoint; never silently weaken it.
promotion_note: 5.5G.6G canonical promotion retained; 5.5G.6I reconciles post-promotion 3D/topology hash drift without weakening protected rules.
